items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Who's that; Mouse? ... [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. He said because Terri said there wasn't any question about who had the better band...

ctx.x: Oh, Mouse Randolph did take Swazey's place.
He said the band wasn't working that much; he said you were working some and then laying off some. He said that's why he quit the band to go J. Frank Terri (phonetic spelling).
